comment: The gateway's wire contract, minus everything upstream publishes. The signed payload families — the connect pair (funduq-connect-provider / funduq-connect-funduq), kyok-call, cancel, resolve, delegation, the actor-chain form — and the two delivery envelopes (delivered-run, delivered-completion, model_dump(by_alias=True)) are vectored in docs/upstream-contract-vectors.json, vendored verbatim from upstream funduq's docs/contract-vectors.json at contract revision 7. What remains this file's to state: the wire version, and each socket's frame vocabulary. All three in-repo implementations' suites (gateway, souk-agent-sdk, souk-client-sdk) plus the Go pod-probe consume this file; the inbound frame sets are the module constants the gateway's dispatch reads, asserted equal in tests.

handshake.comment: Two frames. The provider fetches {ticket, funduqPublicKey} from POST /tickets out of band, computes proof = sign(provider_connect_payload(funduqPublicKey, ticket, nonce)) BEFORE connecting, and opens with hello; funduq answers welcome, whose 'answer' is its signature over funduq_connect_payload(ticket, nonce) — the provider verifies it against the pinned key (confirm_connect / WrongFunduq) before treating the link as open. Refusals close 1008 with a reason; 1011 is reserved for server faults. The /ws/kyok hello carries no maxConcurrentRuns. Attach is NAMELESS: nothing is served until a register frame on the open link.

frames.comment: Frame types per socket, after the two-frame handshake. A run frame is {'type': 'run', **DeliveredRun}; a completion request is {'type': 'completionRequest', 'requestId', **DeliveredCompletion} (actorChain included since contract revision 7). The ack is three-valued: accepted true, false (transient decline — the run stays queued), or false with a 'reason' (permanent refusal). Registration frames are unsigned — the link is the credential: register carries the FULL roster (a smaller batch withdraws omitted names), 'registered' echoes what is now live, deleteAgent/deleteModel remove one record ('deleted' confirms; a refusal — e.g. an agent with a conversation behind it — is answered with an 'error' frame and the socket stays open). query methods are contract.LINK_QUERY_METHODS. Full field semantics in docs/server-mode.md.
